findings.title: A measured sky-and-earth structure
findings.claim: Within the preceding wise-book frame, the focus can carry measured making: the overhead heavens have no pillars, while mountains are cast into the earth so it will not sway. The immediate sequel calls this arrangement God's creation and asks what others have created.
findings.mechanism: The carrier خَلَقَ at 31:10:1:1 takes the measure-and-bound facet when it meets the attributed precision cue at 31:2:4 and the focus's sequence of sky, absent columns, cast mountains, and prevented sway. The sequel's explicit creation challenge connects those parts as one stable work, changing a list of physical features into a coordinated load path.
findings.reader_payoff: The sky's unsupported span and the earth's anchored stability become complementary parts of one ordered scene, which the next verse places inside a challenge about who creates.
findings.containment: The ordinary account of created heavens and placed mountains remains intact. The pillars are explicitly absent; no hidden columns, literal engineering mechanism, or modern physical explanation is claimed. The precision cue at 31:2 is an attributed HFT reading of an exact anchor, and the measure facet is a contextual addition.

epistemic.reason: The focus wording and the immediate-sequel Arabic are supplied, and trusted channel supports nominate the structure. The precision reading of 31:2 is carried by a legacy-unbound HFT trace, so the measured-design link remains qualified.

findings.title: Water arrives as provision
findings.claim: The water sent down from the sky reads as a delivered supply received by the earth and followed by plant growth. The host basmala's mercy language and the immediate sequel's creation attribution allow that physical supply to carry a bounded divine-provision resonance.
findings.mechanism: أَنزَلْنَا at 31:10:18:2 carries downward delivery; the sky and water at 31:10:20:2 and 31:10:21:1 identify what is sent and from where, while growth at 31:10:22:2 supplies the receiving effect. The host basmala at 31:0 and the sequel at 31:11 connect that delivery to divine mercy and creation, changing bare descent into provision reaching a productive ground.
findings.reader_payoff: The sequence links sky, water, receiving earth, and growth as one supply path, while leaving water fully physical.
findings.containment: Water remains actual water sent down from the sky. The reading does not specify rainfall volume, fruit ripening, a human irrigation method, or revelation. Divine benefit is a contextual resonance through the host basmala and 31:11; the focus does not quantify abundance.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel supports and exact focus morphology ground descent, water, and plant growth. Irrigation and divine provision are contextual interpretations, and the unquantified surface does not support an abundance or ripening claim.

findings.title: Anchored ground carries moving life
findings.claim: Mountains settle the earth against a stated risk of sway, and the same ground becomes the place where creatures are spread. The arrangement ties stability to distributed movement; the next verse places both within God's creation.

The sequel's creation statement links the two acts, so anchoring reads as enabling a populated ground rather than stopping all movement.
findings.reader_payoff: Stability and movement coexist: the earth is held against sway while its living creatures spread across it.
findings.containment: The focus describes creatures in or across the earth and names sway as what is prevented. A slow or crawling movement is one bounded facet, not a claim that every creature moves slowly. No hidden subsurface flow is retained.

epistemic.reason: The anchoring, sway, dispersal, and creature carriers are supplied with focus morphology and trusted candidate supports. The slow-ground-movement branch is a bounded contextual facet; the unsupported concealed-flow branch is excluded.

findings.title: The created scene as a visual presentation
findings.claim: The focus's explicit seeing can be read as a visual counterpart to the pericope's recited signs: the ordered scene of creation is presented for understanding, especially after 31:7 depicts recitation met with refusal to hear.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier تَرَوْنَهَا at 31:10:5:1 supplies sight. The HFT attributes sign and composition roles to 31:2 words 2 and 3, precision to word 4, recitation to 31:7 word 2, and understanding-linked hearing to word 9. Those contextual roles meet the focus's serial assembly of sky, earth, creatures, water, and plant growth; the seeing word returns that reception pattern to the physical scene.
findings.reader_payoff: Seeing the created arrangement can become a mode of receiving signs, where perception asks for understanding rather than stopping at visual notice.
findings.containment: The physical creation account remains primary. The visual-recitation relation is an attributed contextual reading; it does not make 31:10 literally recited text or make تَرَوْنَهَا mean only inward insight. The supplied HFT source itself leaves a live alternative that the word is descriptive and the transfer does not occur.

epistemic.reason: The Arabic anchors and focus QAC ref are supplied, but the 31:2 and 31:7 word coordinates, roots, roles, and parallel-system inference remain legacy-unbound nominations. The trace is retained as attributed evidence with its alternative visible.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme

branch_activations.activation: The seeing carrier meets a preceding sign-and-recitation sequence with a refusal-to-hear response, letting visual reception contact interpretation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The physical scene can act as a visible counterpart to recited signs that ask to be understood.

findings.title: Earth receives both anchoring and growth
findings.claim: The earth first receives mountains that hold it against sway, then receives water and becomes the place where plants grow. Its role can shift from broad ground to productive soil without losing the stabilizing scene; the sequel names the whole display as God's creation.
findings.mechanism: أَرْضِ at 31:10:8:2 is the carrier. The later water at 31:10:21:1, growth verb at 31:10:22:2, and repeated in-it location independently trigger the fertile-soil branch. The immediate-sequel connection returns that productive ground to the creation claim, making one location link stability and growth.
findings.reader_payoff: The earth is not only the surface kept from swaying; it is also the receiving medium from which plant life emerges.
findings.containment: The broad earth-as-ground reading stays primary. Fertile soil is a contextual branch activated by water and growth, not a claim that all earth is soft, cultivated, or uniformly fertile.

epistemic.reason: The focus earth, water, and growth refs are supplied and aligned. The soil-quality branch is a contextual reading of the repeated earth location, bounded by its lexical facet.
